stages.imagined.label: Imagined
stages.imagined.description: Proposed and preserved. May be entirely speculative — that is allowed.
stages.developed.label: Developed
stages.developed.description: Worked out: mechanism, prerequisites, consequences and uncertainties are written down.
stages.examined.label: Examined
stages.examined.description: Independently evaluated and challenged by people other than its stewards.
stages.tested.label: Tested
stages.tested.description: At least one experiment, prototype or pilot has been carried out and its outcome recorded.
stages.implemented.label: Implemented
stages.implemented.description: Deployed or enacted in the real world, at some scale.
stages.learned_from.label: Learned from
stages.learned_from.description: Outcomes — successes or failures — have been recorded with explicit lessons.
sections.overview.label: The idea
sections.overview.prompt: What possibility do you want humanity to remember?
sections.motivation.label: Why it could matter
sections.motivation.description: The problem, limit or opportunity it addresses.
sections.mechanism.label: How it might work
sections.prerequisites.label: What would need to exist first
sections.prerequisites.description: Technologies, resources, knowledge or social conditions it depends on.
sections.prerequisites.prompt: What would need to exist first?
sections.uncertainties.label: What we don't know
sections.uncertainties.description: Open questions and how one might find out.
sections.challenges.label: Challenges & counterarguments
sections.challenges.description: Risks, objections and the strongest case against.
sections.consequences.label: What it could enable
sections.consequences.description: Immediate and long-range consequences, intended or not.
sections.origins.label: Origins & prior art
sections.origins.description: Where the idea comes from. The person who submits an idea is not necessarily its originator — credit them here.
sections.origins.prompt: Do you know of related research or earlier proposals?
claimRoles.premise.label: Premise
claimRoles.premise.description: Something the idea assumes to be true.
claimRoles.mechanism.label: Mechanism
claimRoles.mechanism.description: A step in how the idea would work.
claimRoles.prerequisite.label: Prerequisite
claimRoles.prerequisite.description: Something that must exist or be possible first.
claimRoles.consequence.label: Consequence
claimRoles.consequence.description: Something that would follow if the idea were realised.
claimRoles.risk.label: Risk
claimRoles.risk.description: A possible harmful or unwanted consequence.
claimStatuses.unassessed.label: Unassessed
claimStatuses.unassessed.description: Nobody has assessed this claim yet.
claimStatuses.established.label: Established
claimStatuses.established.description: Broad consensus; replicated across independent sources.
claimStatuses.supported.label: Supported
claimStatuses.supported.description: Backed by credible evidence, but not settled.
claimStatuses.hypothesis.label: Hypothesis
claimStatuses.hypothesis.description: A reasoned proposal that has not yet been tested in this context.
claimStatuses.unknown.label: Unknown
claimStatuses.unknown.description: No one currently knows. Marked so the gap stays visible.
claimStatuses.doubtful.label: Doubtful
claimStatuses.doubtful.description: Assessors lean against it, without decisive evidence.
claimStatuses.refuted.label: Refuted
claimStatuses.refuted.description: Contradicted by evidence. Preserved, because failures are knowledge.
claimStatuses.contested.label: Contested
evidenceStances.supports.label: Supports
evidenceStances.supports.description: Makes the claim more likely to be true.
evidenceStances.challenges.label: Challenges
evidenceStances.challenges.description: Makes the claim less likely to be true.
evidenceStances.mixed.label: Mixed
evidenceStances.mixed.description: Supports some aspects and challenges others.

argumentStances.supports.label: Supports
argumentStances.opposes.label: Opposes
argumentStances.qualifies.label: Qualifies
argumentStances.qualifies.description: Accepts the target with conditions or caveats.
dimensions.impact.label: Potential impact
dimensions.impact.description: How much it would change what humanity can do, if realised — regardless of feasibility.
dimensions.impact.question: If this were realised, how much would it change what humanity is capable of?
dimensions.feasibility.label: Feasibility
dimensions.feasibility.description: How achievable it is with foreseeable means.
dimensions.feasibility.question: How achievable is this with foreseeable technology, resources and institutions?
dimensions.plausibility.label: Scientific / logical support
dimensions.plausibility.description: How sound the underlying scientific or logical case is.
dimensions.plausibility.question: How sound is the scientific or logical reasoning behind it?
dimensions.evidence.label: Evidence
dimensions.evidence.description: Perceived strength of the available evidence. Complemented by the structured evidence graph.
dimensions.evidence.question: How strong is the real-world evidence currently available?
dimensions.novelty.label: Novelty
dimensions.novelty.description: How new it is relative to existing ideas and practice.
dimensions.novelty.question: How new is this compared to existing ideas?
dimensions.development.label: Development
dimensions.development.description: How complete and rigorous the idea's development is.
dimensions.development.question: How thoroughly and rigorously is this idea worked out?
dimensions.support.label: Evidential support
dimensions.support.description: Where the claim stands in light of the evidence.
dimensions.support.question: Given the evidence you know of, where does this claim stand?
dimensions.quality.label: Evidence quality
dimensions.quality.description: Methodological soundness and reliability of a piece of evidence.
dimensions.quality.question: How reliable is this evidence, methodologically?
dimensions.relevance.label: Relevance
dimensions.relevance.description: How directly the evidence bears on the claim it is attached to.
dimensions.relevance.question: How directly does this evidence bear on the claim?
dimensions.strength.label: Argument strength
dimensions.strength.description: How strong the reasoning is, whether or not you agree with its conclusion.
dimensions.strength.question: How strong is this argument, regardless of whether you agree?
dimensions.validity.label: Relationship validity
dimensions.validity.description: Whether a stated relationship between two ideas is accurate.
dimensions.validity.question: Is this relationship between the two ideas accurate?
dimensions.useful.label: Useful
dimensions.useful.description: This contribution moved the discussion forward.
dimensions.useful.question: Was this useful?
stanceKinds.important.label: Important
stanceKinds.important.description: I think this matters. (The attention signal.)
stanceKinds.worth_researching.label: Worth researching
stanceKinds.plausible.label: Plausible
stanceKinds.doubtful.label: Doubtful
stanceKinds.ready_now.label: Ready today
stanceKinds.ready_now.description: This could be pursued with today's means.

capacities.communication.label: Communication
involvementStatuses.offering.label: Offering to help
involvementStatuses.offering.description: Willing and able to contribute in this capacity.
involvementStatuses.active.label: Actively involved
involvementStatuses.active.description: Currently working on it in this capacity.
involvementStatuses.concluded.label: Previously involved
relationTypes.requires.label: Requires
relationTypes.requires.description: Cannot be realised without the other idea.
relationTypes.applies.label: Applies
relationTypes.applies.description: Is a specific application of the other idea.
relationTypes.extends.label: Extends
relationTypes.extends.description: Builds on, refines or generalises the other idea.
relationTypes.derived_from.label: Derived from
relationTypes.derived_from.description: Originated as a variant of the other idea.
relationTypes.alternative_to.label: Alternative to
relationTypes.alternative_to.description: A different approach to the same goal.
relationTypes.complements.label: Complements
relationTypes.conflicts_with.label: Conflicts with
relationTypes.conflicts_with.description: Mutually incompatible, or each undermines the other.
initiativeKinds.research.label: Research
initiativeKinds.research.description: Theoretical or literature research, modelling, feasibility studies.
initiativeKinds.experiment.label: Experiment
initiativeKinds.experiment.description: A controlled test of one or more claims.
initiativeKinds.prototype.label: Prototype
initiativeKinds.prototype.description: A working (partial) realisation built to learn.
initiativeKinds.pilot.label: Pilot
initiativeKinds.pilot.description: A limited real-world trial with real participants or conditions.
initiativeKinds.deployment.label: Deployment
initiativeKinds.deployment.description: Production use of the idea at some scale.
initiativeKinds.policy.label: Policy / institutional
initiativeKinds.policy.description: Enacted as law, regulation, or an institutional rule.
initiativeKinds.funding.label: Funding
initiativeKinds.funding.description: Money or resources committed to advance the idea.
initiativeKinds.other.label: Other
initiativeStatuses.planned.label: Planned
initiativeStatuses.active.label: Active
initiativeStatuses.completed.label: Completed
initiativeStatuses.discontinued.label: Discontinued
initiativeStatuses.discontinued.descript: Stopped before completion. Still part of the record.
outcomeResults.succeeded.label: Succeeded
outcomeResults.succeeded.description: Achieved what it set out to show or do.
outcomeResults.partially_succeeded.label: Partially succeeded
outcomeResults.failed.label: Failed
outcomeResults.failed.description: Did not achieve its goal. Failed experiments remain knowledge and are preserved.
outcomeResults.inconclusive.label: Inconclusive
outcomeResults.inconclusive.description: Could not distinguish success from failure.
revisionStatuses.proposed.label: Proposed
revisionStatuses.accepted.label: Accepted
revisionStatuses.accepted.description: Part of the idea's published history.
revisionStatuses.rejected.label: Rejected
revisionStatuses.rejected.description: Not adopted. Preserved with the reason.
revisionStatuses.withdrawn.label: Withdrawn
revisionStatuses.withdrawn.description: Withdrawn by its author before a decision.
lenses.newest.label: Newest
lenses.attention.label: Most supported
lenses.attention.description: How many people marked the idea as important. Popularity — not quality, not truth.
lenses.emerging.label: Emerging
lenses.emerging.description: Fastest-growing attention over the last 30 days.
lenses.evidence.label: Best evidenced
lenses.evidence.description: Strongest assessed evidence, regardless of popularity.
lenses.potential.label: Highest potential
lenses.potential.description: Highest assessed potential impact, regardless of current feasibility. Moonshots belong here.
lenses.feasible.label: Most feasible
lenses.developed.label: Most developed
lenses.developed.description: Most completely worked out: narrative, claims and structure.
lenses.neglected.label: Neglected
lenses.neglected.description: High assessed potential, at-or-below-median attention. Ideas that deserve more eyes.
lenses.contested.label: Contested
lenses.contested.description: Where assessors disagree most. Uncertainty kept visible.
lenses.needs_review.label: Needs review
lenses.needs_review.description: Few independent evaluations yet. Help examine them.
lenses.in_practice.label: In practice
lenses.in_practice.description: Recently tested, implemented or learned from in the real world.
